name: restart
description:
Restart flagged services in LXC containers, on one or several Proxmox hosts in one run.

You normally get here from the **list** report: tick containers there (any host) and click **go to restart** — Hosts and Containers are then prefilled. Or pick host(s) below:

- **Containers** prefills from each selected host's cached report as `host:container` entries. With an **empty** Containers selection a real restart is **refused** unless **Allow all** is ticked (dry run always previews everything flagged).
- The run scans each host fresh and processes them sequentially.
- **Dry run** shows exactly what would be restarted and does nothing; **Restart all flagged services** runs `needrestart-lxc -r` per host (`systemctl restart`, with escalation to kill + start and SIGKILL when KillMode leaves children behind). Non-systemd processes and scope units are reported but never touched automatically.

parameters.name: Hosts
parameters.description: Proxmox host(s) to run on. The Containers list refreshes from the cached report of the selection.

parameters.name: Containers
parameters.description: host:container entries to restart. Usually prefilled from the list report. Empty selection = only a dry run, or a real restart of ALL flagged containers if 'Allow all' is ticked.

parameters.name: Allow all
parameters.description: Safety switch: with an EMPTY Containers selection, a real restart of ALL flagged containers on every selected host is only allowed when this is ticked. Dry run never needs it.

parameters.name: Exclude
parameters.description: Optional: regex of services to exclude on every host (can use alternation, e.g. `^dbus|^rsyslog`).

parameters.name: Action
parameters.description: Restart is preselected; pick dry run to only preview.

values_ui_mapping.dry-run: Dry run (show what would be restarted)
